# B08 — MVP Integration, Legacy Cleanup & Local Distribution (Dev Implementation)

**Status:** Detailed at integration/release level; starts after required upstream contracts exist.  
**Outcome:** Clean clone/install/build/run DeckAgent on a supported local OS; all nine active UCs are connected through one production path, no custom Agent Loop remains reachable.  
**Scope:** Cross-build integration B01–B07; **not** the independent tester's acceptance test plan.  
**Decisions:** ADR-0001…0007, [Repo ownership](../architecture/repository-structure.md).  
**Product authority:** `clean-main/docs/spec/` active UC/FR/NFR/BR; exclude `docs/spec/05-backlog/` unless separately approved.

## 1. Preflight / non-goals

- Each owning build has public contracts and a runnable outcome. If a mandatory UC behavior was omitted earlier, **return ownership to B01–B07** and fix there; don't implement features in B08 simply to make the release checklist green.
- No cloud hosting requirement. **Local Host process + browser UI** on user's machine is consistent with clone/install/run; this is not a remote web service.
- B07's custom Design System flow is part of the active UC-010. If B07 is still Draft/unimplemented, **B08 cannot be called full MVP complete**. Record the blocker explicitly.
- A local POC on Windows does **not** prove macOS/Linux support. Ship/support only platforms actually exercised with clean-install evidence.

## 2. Dev tasks

### B08-IMP-01 — End-to-end composition audit

- Trace UI → Host → domain services → CLI/MCP → persisted result → UI for all enabled flows. Verify only one authority per Workspace, Chat, Request, Deck, permission and Design System. Check no second DB/catalog implementation, no hidden fallback runtime and no direct browser/native file edits.
- Cross-build invariants: stable Chat/Deck IDs, request-scoped grants, native session guard, current theme snapshot, locked format, published revision only, permission checks on every mutation.
- **Developer checks:** API integration, module dependency graph, production import/entrypoint inspection; report any missing UC behavior to its owning build.

### B08-IMP-02 — Remove dead legacy runtime and dependencies

- Trace actual imports from startup through installed package graph. Remove unused Cordis/custom Agent Loop, legacy provider runtime and dead tests/scripts **only when the OpenCode-based replacement is exercised**. Update package/workspace manifests, lockfile, TypeScript refs and README commands accordingly.
- Do not delete DeckService/Host/UI code that is still reused. Do not leave stale docs advertising both runtimes. Keep historical commits as reference, not bundled production modules.
- **Developer checks:** no custom runtime reachable from production entrypoint; no unresolved imports; project builds from scratch after clean dependency install.

### B08-IMP-03 — Local clone/install/run verification

- Document prerequisites: Node/pnpm versions, pinned/tested OpenCode CLI, required environment, local storage location and safe key entry; no remote backend installation. Verify clean clone → install → build → start Local Host → UI load → provider setup → first Chat request → HTML deck preview.
- Exercise restart/reopen (persisted data), UI disconnect/reconnect, Stop, provider removal and unavailable project folder. Validate user project files unchanged. Test **Windows x64** as initial candidate, and only list additional OS as supported after real smoke evidence.
- **Developer checks:** fresh-environment smoke logs, command exit codes, a minimal end-to-end fixture with real CLI, no credentials in logs or repo. Avoid relying only on a developer machine that already has hidden global config.

### B08-IMP-04 — Failure recovery, data and security audit

- Check incomplete staging/DB transactions, data migrations, failed provider checks, missed/lost events, active Request after Host restart, concurrent Chat runs, stale native session, forged MCP request, symlink escapes, prompt-injected source content and Stop races.
- Verify application stores generated content outside project folders, secrets outside normal SQLite/event records, and no Chat can read another Chat's material even through tools.
- **Developer checks:** negative integration fixtures and real CLI policy smoke where needed. If a dangerous operation is only prompt-blocked and not Host-blocked, mark BLOCKED and fix the owning module.

### B08-IMP-05 — Requirement ownership and Dev handoff

- Make a lightweight **coverage inventory** of the nine active UCs, each main/alternative flow and referenced FR/NFR/BR with its owning build and implementation evidence (code path and relevant Dev check). This is an engineering gap audit, **not** creation of the tester's test cases or formal UC execution reports.
- Record final change list, commands/tests with pass/fail, supported OS/runtime versions, open limitations, implementation-known risks and branches/commits for the independent tester. No claim that testing lane is complete.

## 3. Developer release checks

| Check | Expected result |
|---|---|
| Clean install, typecheck, build | No hidden dependency on local machine/global config |
| No legacy runtime in reachable production imports | `opencode run` is sole production Agent Loop |
| Local provider → generic Chat → first deck → follow-up edit → read-only Q&A | One integrated app, same Chat and Deck |
| Workspace source reads / approval / forbidden writes | Host boundaries cannot be bypassed |
| Stop/fail/restart/reconnect | Correct terminal state and last-good artifact preservation |
| Custom DS → generation + edit/delete DS → reopen old Deck | Old Deck theme unchanged; B07 must be implemented |
| Credentials/provider settings | Key never appears in regular app state, event, log or repo |
| Clean supported-platform smoke | Documented install/start works on tested platform(s) |

Unit/integration checks from owning builds remain required; B08 runs the combined suite and release smoke. Tester's independent UC coverage and findings are **outside this plan** and may arrive afterward.

## 4. Dev Done / handoff

**Dev Done** only when: clean-machine local product works on declared supported platform(s); all 9 active UCs have implementation owners and integrated entrypoints; B07 completed; dead runtime removed; code/API/security/integration checks passed or explicitly marked as blockers (any critical blocker means not Done); handoff includes known gaps and observed command output.

**Handoff:** exact branch/commit, install steps, supported OS/CLI versions, sample fixture or steps to exercise product, developer check evidence, implementation limitations and links to source Specs. Independent tester uses their own test strategy, not this build file.
